notes: November 2026 review. An omitted operator may serve additional routes in an otherwise covered city. The catalogs are periodically rebuilt against dated service calendars.

Japan includes publicly reusable, identifiable boarding stops and dated services from the listed open feeds. ODPT feeds requiring registration/the provider’s redistribution terms remain excluded until access and rights are confirmed.

The US download catalog is based on NTD urban areas, with city selection by boarding stops. Private operators, unavailable URLs, and services without current dated calendars can be absent. UK updates can differ from printed schedules. Operator live diversions are not part of these static downloads.
